Class PromptRegistry

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.prompt.core.PromptRegistry
@ApplicationScoped public class PromptRegistry extends Object
============================================================================ PromptRegistry — ApplicationScoped service managing template lifecycle. ============================================================================ Responsibilities: • CRUD operations on PromptTemplates, scoped by tenant. • Status-transition enforcement via the PromptTemplate.TemplateStatus FSM. • Publish-gate validation (blocks publishing if warnings remain). • Two resolution modes exposed to the engine: – resolveLatest(String, String) – latest PUBLISHED version. – resolvePinned(String, String, String) – exact version. • In-memory LRU cache for hot-path reads; invalidated on any write. Multi-tenancy: • All queries are scoped by tenantId. • Platform built-ins (tenantId == null) are visible to every tenant but are read-only (mutations are rejected). Persistence: Delegated entirely to PromptRegistry.PromptTemplateRepository, which is the contract for the Hibernate Reactive + Panache implementation. Thread safety: The cache is a ConcurrentHashMap. All repository calls return
invalid reference 
Uni<T>
— the service never blocks the event loop.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<PromptTemplate> create(PromptTemplate template)
      Persists a new template. The status is forced to PromptTemplate.TemplateStatus.DRAFT regardless of what the caller supplied — new templates always start as drafts.
      Parameters:
      template - the template to save
      Returns:
      the persisted template (with status forced to DRAFT)

    • resolveLatest

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<PromptTemplate> resolveLatest(String templateId, String tenantId)
      Returns the latest PUBLISHED version of a template visible to the given tenant. Built-in templates (tenantId=null) are included.
      Throws:
      PromptRegistry.TemplateNotFoundException - when no published version exists

    • resolvePinned

    • publish

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<PromptTemplate> publish(String templateId, String version, String tenantId)
      Transitions a template from DRAFT → PUBLISHED. Publish-gate: if the template still has validation warnings the transition is rejected with an IllegalStateException whose message lists the warnings.

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<PromptTemplate> deprecate(String templateId, String version, String tenantId)
